Charlie, that's a flat-out lie. I was never in security this round — not at tick 7, not at any point. My route was oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, navigation. Security isn't even on that path, and I have no reason to detour there. You're fabricating a sighting to deflect.

That's a lot of backtracking and it covers nearly the whole middle of the map, including paths adjacent to navigation via security. Security connects to navigation directly. You had the means and opportunity.

I'm voting Charlie. Diana, I'd urge you to do the same — Charlie's lie about seeing me in security is the tell.
